description: Source code for Scrum module in an Odoo/OpenERP project, defining models for Scrum teams, projects, sprints, backlogs, tasks, and meetings.

classes.name: scrum_team
classes.description: Model representing a Scrum team with a name and associated users.

classes.name: scrum_project
classes.description: Model extending project with Scrum-specific fields like product owner, tasks, sprint size, and hierarchy.

classes.name: scrum_sprint
classes.description: Model representing a Scrum sprint with methods to calculate progress, effective hours, and planned hours.

classes.name: scrum_product_backlog
classes.description: Model for product backlog items, including progress calculations and search functionality.

classes.name: scrum_task
classes.description: Model extending project tasks with Scrum-specific backlog association and project linkage.

classes.name: scrum_meeting
classes.description: Model for Scrum meetings with details about date, sprint, and discussion points.

methods.name: _calc_progress
methods.description: Calculates progress percentage based on backlog or task hours and progress.

methods.name: _calc_effective
methods.description: Calculates total effective hours from backlog or tasks.

methods.name: _calc_planned
methods.description: Calculates total planned hours from backlog or tasks.

methods.name: onchange_project_id
methods.description: Updates product owner, Scrum master, and end date when project is changed in sprint.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Custom search for backlog items using a specific pattern.

methods.name: onchange_backlog_id
methods.description: Sets project ID based on selected backlog item.
